# LCARS

> Framework-agnostic LCARS (Star Trek computer interface) design system for web apps: plain CSS classes and design tokens in cascade layers, themes for every Star Trek series, and an optional dependency-free ES module. Works with any stack that outputs HTML.

Essentials:
- Load `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/janos97/lcars@master/dist/lcars.min.css` (and optionally `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/janos97/lcars@master/dist/lcars.js` as a module); put `class="lcars"` on <html>.
- Page = `.lcars-app` > `.lcars-frame` (parts: `__elbow-top`, `__bar-top`, `__side`, `__main`, `__elbow-bottom`, `__bar-bottom`, all direct children).
- Color pieces with `lcars-c-{primary|secondary|tertiary|accent|muted|alert}` so themes work; themes via `data-lcars-theme` = tng, tos, snw, dis, ent, ds9, voy, nemesis, ld, pro, pic, red-alert.
- 15 components, 130 classes, 55 tokens; every one is listed in the reference and manifest.

## Docs

- [Full context (single file)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/llms-full.txt): rules, mistakes, complete reference and all recipes — load this when implementing.
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/docs/reference.md): rules, components, utilities, tokens, themes, JS.
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/docs/recipes.md): copy-paste markup for app-shell, header-only, sidebar-nav, dashboard-tiles, section-heading, data-table, form, tabs, dialog, svg-control.
- [Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/dist/lcars.manifest.json): the same API as JSON (classes, tokens, themes, attributes).

## Examples

- [Component library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/examples/index.html): every component with its source.
- [Operations dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/examples/dashboard.html): a complete app.
- [Starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/janos97/lcars/master/examples/starter.html): minimal page to copy.
